newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Green shoe exercised in EDP sale.
newsitem.headline: Green shoe exercised in EDP sale.

text.p: The green shoe for 16.36 million shares was exercised in the partial privatisation of state utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, bourse officials said.
They said that in the direct sale orders for 31.02 million shares came from the U.S., 22.44 million from Britain, 12.687 million from Portugal and 14.02 million from the rest of the world.

The Portuguese government earned slightly more than 390 billion escudos from the sale of 30 percent of the capital of EDP, Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira Santos told reporters at a special session of Lisbon bourse.
The figure included 211.09 billion escudos from the public offer for sale (OPV), bourse officials said.

Fernando Ulrich of Banco Portugues de Investimento, one of the global coordinators of the sale, said demand in the domestic and international direct sale exceeded 2.4 billion shares, compared with a supply of 80.172 million shares.
Demand exceeded supply in this tranche by about 30 times.
